sentences.en: She cannily concealed her delight at his suggestion.

sentences.en: It can flourish or struggle cannily to survive.

sentences.en: Le Pen, a consummate political campaigner, cannily combined the two issues.

sentences.en: The review that Gates cannily put in hand included opinions about gays among the serving military, which found that some 70 percent thought repeal would have little or no effect.

sentences.en: She built up her fortune by cannily playing the stock market.
